newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg to upgrade Shell's Wood River.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg to upgrade Shell's Wood River.

text.p: M.W. Kellogg Co said it is providing engineering, procurement and construction management services as part of a multi-million-dollar project to increase production of reformulated gasoline at Shell Oil Products' Wood River Refinery in Illinois.

Scheduled for completion in early 1998, the project will allow the Royal Dutch/Shell Group subsidiary produce fuels that meet pending U.S. Enviromental Protection Agency product specifications for reduced NOx emmissions, Kellogg said.
A spokesman for the Dresser Industries Inc subsidiary said Shell would not allow the release of additional information about the project.

The refinery, located on the Mississippi River in western Illinois, now has a crude distillation capacity of 271,000 barrels daily and catalytic cracking capacity of 85,000 barrels per day. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
